_themeNote: v2 reverses the v1 'night is permanent' rule: light and dark both ship, day is the default, and the toggle is manual (no clock, no prefers-color-scheme). `mode` here is the server-rendered default and the no-JS answer; _includes/components/theme-init.njk corrects it from localStorage before first paint. Pages not yet migrated to the v2 ramp pin `mode: night` in their own front matter; those pins come off per Phase 4 batch.
_statsNote: Same rule as the footer spec strip. The reference concept's home stat bar read '8 Ramen houses' and '12h Tonkotsu simmer'. Both are corrected here: CLIENT_FACTS.md forbids publishing a global location total, and no simmer time is confirmed anywhere. Do not revert.
_sloganNote: EXACT STRING, per DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 'Copy constants'. 'Housemade' is one word with no hyphen, a deliberate exception to the house-made spelling in voice-tone.md. Do not 'correct' it, and do not correct other instances to match. OPEN: five templates carry comments noting that 'crafted daily' asserts a noodle cadence not yet confirmed in CLIENT_FACTS.md. Those comments stay until the client confirms; see the Phase 2 report.
